svg.aria-label: DeltaQuant pipeline: DhanHQ, Groq, Telegram and Langfuse feed a five-stage flow -- Universe and Data, Screen and Rank, LLM Agent Review, Risk and Compliance, and Paper Execution -- with a Postgres-backed memory and audit layer feeding lessons back into the next cycle.
svg.text: DhanHQ is the sole market-data source. Bounded LLM judgement is sandwiched between a deterministic screen and a deterministic risk gate.

g.text: a gap just skips a symbol

svg.text: Every fill, rejection, and reasoning trace is durable — nothing about a decision is thrown away

g.text: Signal history — every rejection reason, not just pass/fail
Daily risk state & strategy performance stats
tracked for whether they actually helped
